title: Amazing
text:

 He also talked us through the different areas we stopped at. We first stopped at Nerja where we had an hour or so to enjoy the weather and views, take photos, have ice cream, we then went to visit the caves which was pretty cool. title: Our guide Michael did a wonderful...
text: Our guide Michael did a wonderful job. He let us choose where we wanted to spend the most time and we even got to lay on the beach in the sun for an hour. The caves were interesting and included an audio guide. Paella at the restaurant on the beach was good. As you walked in you could see them cooking it over a flame on a huge skillet. Two of us were allergic to shellfish and they were accommodating with other options. We loved this tour.
author: Janet_J

title: Seemed a bit of a rushed tour
text: Absolutely stunning inside but I would of liked a little more time to digest what I was seeing and listening to via the audio equipment, we went on a Monday which was free entry but 1 euro for the audio equipment, good value. Public transport directly to the entrance regularly and a nice cafe awaits for when you are waiting for your tour time. Our weather was not that good, we had a lot of rain so we never walked the gardens. Visitor gift shop at the entrance and toilets available, my recommendation would be to wear sensible footwear.
